Sentence (English): I love my new Bosch dishwasher--it's very quiet and cleans well--but not rinsing dishes first is hard to get used to!
Comments (English): [ Love Bosch, but not perfect. ] || ---------------- || I love my new Bosch dishwasher--it's very quiet and cleans well--but not rinsing dishes first is hard to get used to! Because I don't wash every day, the inside of the dishwasher sometimes smells! The real problem, though, was the lingering moisture on the dishes after the cycle had been completed. I would sometimes run the dishwasher at night, but in the morning many dishes and silverware still had water on them. After contacting Bosch I was told to wait 30 minutes after the cycle to allow appliance to cool. After advice from a friend, I now open the door after 30 minutes and hold open with a rolled towel to let steam escape. Doing this has helped dry my dishes more thoroughly, but I still wish it wasn't necessary.

Maybe it will come in time, but I'm still trying to work out the best way to stack the dishes in this dishwasher. - I wish it had the "pop open" feature after the dishes are done like some other dishwashers - The install guys were pretty incompetent, but this has nothing to do with the dishwasher or Costco of course. Sentence (English): I have never gone through the trouble to give a detailed review for a product, but this is an exception.
Comments (English): [ A great dishwasher except for one visual flaw. ] || ---------------- || I have never gone through the trouble to give a detailed review for a product, but this is an exception. My husband bought this dishwasher for my birthday (yes, I asked him to! ) since the house we just bought is older, and has never had a dishwasher installed. He and our son had it out and hooked up in no time. It's great that it's on wheels, so you can move it around the kitchen as needed. It also does not take up a great deal of room. This dishwasher runs very quiet and it cleans the dishes so well. As you can see from the pictures, the hose and plug are both included, so you don't need to buy any addtional hoses, just hook the hose up to your kitchen faucet, plug it in, and turn the washer on! I like the features of delay start, sanitize mode, hidden buttons, easy programming, soap dispenser setup, it uses less water, and it's easy to clean. I like the features of the auto-sense, so the washer auto-adjusts adjusts to how long the cycle needs to run. Another great thing is I purposely did not pre-wash one load just to see how well it would clean. The dishes came out sparkling! It's also stainless steel, so it matches our other appliances. One other thing is that this portable dishwasher can eventually convert to a built-in if you need it to. We had a built-in Bosch in our other house, and this one beats it hands down! If you are looking for a portable, this one is great!

Sentence (English): I am completely disappointed with this dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Lacks Important Feature ] || ---------------- || I am completely disappointed with this dishwasher. For the price it overpromises and undelivers. The most annoying feature of this machine is the inability to lock the LCD screen when the machine is powered off. Being an underbench dishwasher, not having this function leads to the machine being accidentally turned on several times per day when standing in front of it to use the kitchen bench or sink. The only way to activate the "Button Lock" Bosch boast that it features is when the machine is actually turned on. Sure, you can turn the machine on and without starting a cycle, select the Button Lock feature, however the LCD screen will continue to flash the cycle you have chosen until you turn it off. Who wants that in their kitchen at night, lighting up the dark! Dishwashers from 15 years ago had the ability to lock a LCD when in off mode, why can't Bosch with all their German engineering and technology integrate this one minor but so important feature into these expensive machines. I'm now stuck with this until it dies or I get so sick of it I sell it secondhand. I definitely wouldn't purchase again.

The silverware baskets are awkward. The door needs to be fully opened, the tray pulled out, in order to reach beyond the first [__] basket section. It does not clean as well, either. I'm finding I need to more thoroughly rinse plates and silverware. My appliance repairman highly recommended the Bosch brand. I will continue to get used to this machine. However, I DID discover lovely magnetic door covers which easily hid the scratch/dent marks.

Sentence (English): I needed a white dishwasher in a hurry.
Comments (English): [ Great mid-range dishwasher ] || ---------------- || I needed a white dishwasher in a hurry. There were 6 models available locally with a very wide range of prices. This one was in the middle, but had a good balance of features compared to all the others. The fitment in the existing opening was perfect, and the simple controls are very nice. The quick wash feature is definitely a plus, as the cycles get longer each generation of washers it seems. The interior volume holds as much as the higher end washer it replaced, and the noise level is also about the same. The door feels a little heaver to move than the last dishwasher, but I think it is because of more insulation. The water and electrical connections were in the same place,so installation was easy. Our impression after 3 weeks is that this dishwasher will more than meet our needs. Only caution is to be careful around the sheet metal on the electrical connection box, the corners can be a little sharp. Definitely happy with the unit, a good balance of features, quality and price point.

Sentence (English): We purchased this after looking at several dishwashers at Home Depot, Lowes and other locations.
Comments (English): [ Good. but.  ] || ---------------- || We purchased this after looking at several dishwashers at Home Depot, Lowes and other locations. This one had good reviews. We ended up purchasing from Lowes but had to wait a couple weeks for it to come in. I'm giving it 3 stars based only on Kitchenaid's service, which is. well. pretty disappointing. We had a problem with the control panel upon the second time using it. Some of the buttons wouldn't work. I called customer service and was told that a "local" repairman was not available for over a month in our area. I said that's unacceptable for a brand-new dishwasher. I was told that I would receive an email from Kitchenaid Service Department to discuss options but I never received the email. I did however receive the email to review this dishwasher. We ended up unplugging it and plugging it back in (a reset of sorts) and that fixed it for one load. Then we are back to having to use "ProWash" or "ExpressWash" but no "Normal" or "Tough". So, the fix is, a reset that includes getting down on our hands and knees to unplug and replug it in. After spending nearly $1,000.00 I expect the Kitchenaid service to have some concern and have a better plan (by the way, we figured out the "reset" ourselves). Cleans good most of the time, but I just wish we had the options for other washes without having to unplug the thing everytime. So overall, we like the dishwasher. we wished the buttons worked. we've only had it installed for just about a month. So far, the Kitchenaid service has been pretty much non-existent. So, if you live in a high population area, your service might be better? I really can't say for sure.

Comments (English): [ Looks great, but issue out of the box.  ] || ---------------- || I'll start this review by saying we love the look and concept of this dishwasher. We are a small family that doesn't produce many dishes so having the ability to run smaller loads with the option to have an additional load if we happen to have more dishes is fantastic and what drew us to this particular model. However, the positive part of this review ends there. We ordered our new appliance in August and waited nearly 8 weeks to receive them. Which wasn't a big deal since we were starting our kitchen remodel in November (2022). After having our kitchen torn apart for nearly 6 months, this past weekend we were finally able to install and test our new appliances. On Saturday (Apr 8, 2023), we installed the dishwasher and ran our first small load to make sure it works. It didn't even make it through a complete wash cycle before popping the GFI breaker. After spending time troubleshooting on our own and it never making it through a complete cycle in either drawer without popping the GFI (we have to separate and dedicated GFIs), we decided to contact GE customer service to see what could be done. We learned that GE doesn't have technicians in our area so we were told someone would contact us to schedule service to trouble shoot the issue. After waiting all of Monday and not receiving a call, we called back and the second representative we spoke to was able to get an appointment with a local technician and texted us a confirmation. The tech came out on Wednesday and did all the troubleshooting they could to try and identify the issue with no luck. We were told they would order parts, however, there was no telling when they would arrive. There was mention that becuase this is such a new product parts aren't readily available. Today, my husband called customer service to express our dissatisfaction and frustration that we have a brand new product that doesn't work and a service ticket that can't be completed with no realistic timeline on when parts will arrive. He was sent back and forth between Customer Relations and Customer Service for over an hour with each rep telling him they couldn't help and that the other work group would have to help him. A classic throw the problem over the fence situation. So, I called back and immediately asked to speak to a manager. Instead of being transferred to a manager, the rep acted as a go-between placing me on hold each time she "talked to the manager". After waiting on hold for 15 minutes I was hung up on. To receive a brand-new product and have it malfunction right out of the box is frustrating but we understand it can happen. To have a tech come out and tell us there is no telling when they will receive what they need to properly fix said brand-new appliance is unacceptable. To call customer relations with the hope that some answers could be given or attempts to make it right only to receive the runaround and be pushed back and forth between work groups makes us regret purchasing from GE altogether. Out of the four appliances we purchased (refrigerator, microwave, dishwasher, and range) 50% of them came with issues and what we feel is less than adequate quality for the price that was paid. We are highly disappointed in our purchase and unable to give a proper review of the product since it doesn't work and customer service/relations were completely unhelpful. Writing this with the hope that others don't experience the same issues.

Sentence (English): The Bosch 300 series does an excellent job cleaning dishes.
Comments (English): [ Impressed! ] || ---------------- || The Bosch 300 series does an excellent job cleaning dishes. The last dishwasher we owned did such a poor job that we were seriously considering reclaiming the cabinet space where the washer is installed. Very impressed with how well the Bosch washer cleans. I installed the washer myself and installation was not difficult. I wish I had been aware of the extras that are needed for the installation. A standard power cord is provided with the washer but I don't have a receptacle to plug into so I needed a Bosch power cord/junction box that is sold separately. I also needed an adapter for the water supply line. So as usual I had an extra trip to Lowes. This machine is very quiet and has nice features. The light that shines on the floor indicating that it is running is a simple but nice feature. Lots of features and functionality for the price range.

Sentence (English): A couple of months ago we bought this dishwasher to replace a similar Kitchenaid dishwasher (the appearance of the door and handle is virtually identical to the old machine).
Comments (English): [ Early on a Very Nice Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || A couple of months ago we bought this dishwasher to replace a similar Kitchenaid dishwasher (the appearance of the door and handle is virtually identical to the old machine). The new machine is much quieter, has a much more useful third rack, a middle rack we don't like quite as well because the center area doesn't hold bowls in a way that we had found very useful in the old machine, and a lower rack very similar to the old machine. The new washer cleans dishes very well, as did the old machine. I noticed when the machine was being installed that there is quite a bit more plastic in the base where the legs/levelers are in the new machine. The door hinges don't seem as strong on the new machine; the door twists when we are opening it unless we grip it right in the middle when pulling on it to unlatch it. The buttons to control the cycle selections, which are on the top edge of the door are very sensitive. Quite often when opening the door to load a few dishes we will inadvertently choose a cycle (the lights all come on) because we have brushed one of the buttons by touching the edge of the door. We then have to touch the cancel button to get the cycle cancelled. A minor inconvenience. While this review has pointed put a few things we don't like, all in all this is a very quiet dishwasher with a very useful third rack that cleans dishes very well. We like it.

Sentence (English): We bought this dishwasher about 3 months ago….sorry we did.
Comments (English): [ Do not like this dishwasher at all ] || ---------------- || We bought this dishwasher about 3 months ago….sorry we did. I liked the looks of it plus the shelving inside… the top rack is deeper than most other racks on dishwashers. The silverware holder is all one piece so does not come apart which is nice. You can lay the prongs down on the bottom rack so if you are washing something like a crockpot it fits nicely. Now…what I do not like about it… does not dry automatically . Have to use the dry boost which extends the time longer and the dishes still have wet spots on them! My major complaint though is this….the dishwasher will not cancel out when you try to stop the cycle! It says hold the start button down for 3 seconds to cancel. Do that and it doesn't cancel. I might add that we have to do this a lot because the dishwasher will go on w/o even touching the buttons! Our 15 month old grandson will touch the top of the dishwasher panel…not pressing any buttons, and it goes on. You open the door and it goes on! So…a lot of the times it runs through a cycle and there is nothing in it. Mind you, the lowest timed cycle is 80 mins! Very frustrating. I might also add that they do not eleven give you owners manuals anymore. Anything you need to know about it you have to look up online. Am I going to have to put up with this for the next 6 to 8 years. Sorry we bought this.

Sentence (English): This dishwaster is good, but the additional features it has over any of the lower-end series doesn't seem to be worth it.
Comments (English): [ Don't see the value in the additional features ] || ---------------- || This dishwaster is good, but the additional features it has over any of the lower-end series doesn't seem to be worth it. I think an 800-series would have all the needed features without additional cost this one brings. The Good: -The 30 and 60 minute wash cycles are great and the main reason I wanted this model. No waiting 2.5 hours for a load to finish -The front panel shows exactly where the washer is in the cycle, along with telling you when it will finish -Third rack is very flexible and helps find a place for things that normally don't have a good spot -Generally quiet, but it's certainly not 38db quiet -Dishes always come out clean no matter how I have them loaded The Bad: -The racks are on ball bearings which makes them very touchy. Even though my rails are dead-level, they still have a tendency to roll back into the washer the minute I let go -The cleanout filter is very difficult to get to because I can't pull the lower rack out far enough. So I find myself needing to contort myself and the filter to pull it out. This also involves turning the mesh screen sideways, leading to any food that collected on it falling back into the tub -The internal lights don't actually turn on when you open the dishwasher. They only turn on when you press the On/Off button before you start to run a load, which is really when I need them the least. I would expect the lights to work every time I open the door so I can see what I'm doing -The stainless steel toe kick is a nice addition, but it's sort of cheap looking because it requires two phillips screws in the front of the plate, ruining a clean look

Otherwise the dishes will get damp again if they sit in there closed up for a while. That's the reason for 4 stars instead of 5. Sentence (English): As a lazy cancer patient, I cannot live without this Haier X3000 dishwasher.
Comments (English): As a lazy cancer patient, I cannot live without this Haier X3000 dishwasher. It fits even with limited space in the kitchen, and its ultra-narrow design makes it easy to find a place in a cupboard. And, unlike the drab functions of other regular dishwashers, it also washes pots! This is also great! You don't need to wash dishes and pots by hand, which saves trouble! The operation is simple and easy to understand, especially the appointment function, which makes people feel more at ease when going out, and enjoy the clean tableware directly after returning home. In short, this dishwasher is practical, beautiful, easy to operate, and environmentally friendly. It is my favorite!
Comments (Original): 作为一名懒癌患者，我的生活离不开这款海尔X3000洗碗机。即便厨房空间有限，它也不受影响，其超窄的设计让它在橱柜中轻松找到安身之地。而且，与其他普通洗碗机单调无味的功能不同，它还能洗锅！这也太棒了吧！洗碗、洗锅都不用手洗了，多省事呀！操作简单易懂，特别是有预约功能，让人更能安心出门，回家后直接享受清洗干净的餐具。总之，这款洗碗机实用、美观、易操作、环保，是我的最爱！

Sentence (English): We are happy with this dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Very good quality price ] || ---------------- || We are happy with this dishwasher. The best thing is that it washes well on the eco program and also on the quick 1 hour program (the ones I've tried so far). It consumes less than the one we had before, which was very old. You can also schedule delayed washing, both manually from the device and from the mobile application. On the other hand, the tray to put cutlery, although it is slower to place than when it has a basket, it seems that it cleans them better because they are more separated from each other, and also leaves more space to put crockery on the lower trays. However, it takes space away from the glass tray, so it can be adapted and lowered a bit to allow a slightly larger container or bowl to be placed, or also raised for taller dishes on the lower tray. I hope the mechanism is durable. What I liked least is that the trays when you take them out slide worse than the one we had before and it seems less robust in general. But for the price, it's great.

Sentence (English): We are happy with this dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Very good quality price ] || ---------------- || We are happy with this dishwasher. The best thing is that it washes well in the eco program and also in the 1 hour quick program (the ones I have tried so far). It consumes less than the one we had before, which was very old. You can also program the washing on a delayed basis, both manually from the device and from the mobile application. On the other hand, the tray to put cutlery, although it is slower to place than when it has a basket, seems to clean them better because they are further apart from each other, and also leaves more space to put dishes on the lower trays. However, it takes up space from the glass tray so it can be adapted and lowered a little to allow placing a slightly larger container or bowl, or also raised for taller dishes on the lower tray. I hope the mechanism is durable. What I liked the least is that the trays, when you take them out, slide worse than the one we had before and it seems less robust in general. But for the price, it's great.
Comments (Original): [ Muy bien calidad precio ] || ---------------- || Estamos contentos con este lavavajillas.Lo mejor es que lava bien en programa eco y también en el rápido de 1 hora (los que he probado hasta ahora). Consume menos que el que teníamos antes que era muy antiguo.Además puedes programar el lavado en diferido, tanto manualmente desde el aparato, como desde la aplicación móvil.Por otro lado, la bandeja para poner cubiertos aunque es más lento para colocar que cuando tiene cesta, parece que los limpia mejor porque están más separados entre si, y además deja más espacio para poner vajilla en las bandejas inferiores. Sin embargo, le resta espacio a la bandeja de los vasos por lo que ésta se puede adaptar y bajar un poco para permitir colocar algun recipiente o cuenco un poco más grande, o tambíen subir para platos más altos en la bandeja inferior. Espero que el mecanismo sea duradero.Lo que menos me ha gustado es que las bandejas cuando las sacas, deslizan peor que el que teníamos antes y parece menos robusto en general. Pero por el precio, está genial.

Sentence (English): We replaced our 20 year old dishwasher with this so we are a bit biased in rating.
Comments (English): [ Quiet and spacious ] || ---------------- || We replaced our 20 year old dishwasher with this so we are a bit biased in rating. First off, it is VERY quiet in all cycles and our house is quiet. Second, the third racks carries lots of utensils and CHOPSTICKS (we usually put 10 pairs per wash). We cook daily and each wash the machine can clean all pots, dishes, bowls and utensils from 5 people. Now, it takes minimum 2 hours per wash so we wash during tv time and open the door once done, and everything dry in the morning. We found this method working well even without heat drying. Overall we love this machine from the experience of one month of using.

A replacement control board was almost $300 plus a service call of $150+ while a replacement of similar quality and better features was only $100 more. What should have been a direct simple replacement as can be found on several YouTube DIY videos, it was not because where the previous dishwasher was a direct electrical hard wired unit at the front of the unit, this current model came with a preinstalled AC plug connection on the rear of the unit and now needed an outlet box to be purchased and installed. The outlet box needs to be installed in an adjacent cabinet bay, and a new hole needs to be drilled between the cabinet bays to run the existing AC feed and Bosch cable. The hole needs to be large enough to pass the Cable connection plug through. Bosch also does not include the 90 degree elbow to connect the water line, so you need to seperatly purchse that or try to remove the old one if doing a replacement which can be a challenge on an old unit. The features and cleaning are excellent and the drying is typical for Bosch units where there is always some water condensation left after completing the cycle since the Bosch units do not have a heated dryer option which is typical of European designed units.
